scripts.dev: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs local .env.local -- node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev
scripts.build: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs local .env.local -- node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
scripts.build:production: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs production .env.production.local -- node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs staging .env.staging.local -- node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
scripts.test: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs test - -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.staging:soak:safe: node scripts/run-with-process-tree.mjs --timeout-ms 1800000 -- node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs staging .env.staging.local -- node node_modules/vite-node/vite-node.mjs --config vitest.config.ts scripts/staging-soak.ts
scripts.cf:dry-run: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs production .env.production.local -- node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --dry-run
scripts.cf:dry-run:staging: node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs staging .env.staging.local -- node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --dry-run
scripts.preview: npm run cf:build && node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs production .env.production.local -- node node_modules/@opennextjs/cloudflare/dist/cli/index.js preview
scripts.deploy: npm run cf:build && node scripts/run-with-app-env.mjs production .env.production.local -- node node_modules/@opennextjs/cloudflare/dist/cli/index.js deploy
